proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ _ a
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg h, fun z hz => spectrum_nonneg_of_nonneg h hz⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := h1
    rw [← cfc_id ℝ a]
    exact cfc_nonneg fun x hx => h2 x hx
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] (a : A), 0 ≤ a ↔ star a = a ∧ ∀ z ∈ spectrum ℝ a, 0 ≤ z
